question: Which of the following states is related to Gatka, which was inducted into the 37th National Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Gatka is a traditional martial art form that originated in the state of **Punjab**, India.
 
• It is closely associated with the Sikh community and is often performed during religious and cultural festivals.
 
• The art of Gatka involves the use of various weapons such as sticks, swords, and shields.
 
• Gatka was included in the 37th National Games, recognizing its cultural significance and promoting traditional sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **History and Origin:**

 
 
• Gatka is believed to have originated during the times of Guru Hargobind, the sixth Sikh Guru, who emphasized the necessity of self-defense.
 
• The martial art has historical roots dating back to the 17th century.
 
 
 
• **Techniques and Training:**
 
 
• Practitioners of Gatka are trained in the use of various traditional weapons and hand-to-hand combat techniques.
 
• The training emphasizes discipline, agility, and coordination.
 
 
 
• **Modern Recognition:**
 
 
• Gatka has been recognized by various sports organizations and is promoted at national and international levels.
 
• Efforts are being made to preserve and promote this traditional art form through various competitions and cultural programs.
 
 
 
• **Cultural Significance:**
 
 
• Gatka is not only a martial art but also a significant part of Sikh culture and heritage.
 
• It is performed during important Sikh festivals like Vaisakhi and Hola Mohalla, showcasing the martial spirit and valor of the Sikh community.
